name: self-harm-is-caught-by-the-phrase-list-alone
pins:
The mirror of subtle-emergency-caught-by-the-second-layer, and the reason both exist. That scenario proves layer two can catch what layer one misses; this one proves layer one catches what layer two misses — the understudy's judgement reasons by co-occurrence of a body part and a severity word, and self-harm has neither. Written after a falsification pass found that sabotaging the phrase list left every other scenario green: layer two happened to subsume it on all of them, so the whole first layer could have been deleted without a single scenario noticing.

Psychiatry is deliberately absent from the seeded departments precisely because this belongs to the emergency path and not to a booking flow.

turns.message: I feel suicidal and I don't want to be here any more
